items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I called a couple… Believe it or not, I called Stanley Crouch, who’s a character. But he said, “Well, they… somebody’s gonna release it after you’re gone, anyway. You might as well let it out.”

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, refused to have it released for years. And one of the reasons… Well, first of all, because of the history. Nobody… so obviously, it was like the Watergate thing. Nobody said it’s gonna be recorded, schmuck. (laughs) So I resented that, and also the fact that I played bad on it. So I called a couple… Believe it or not, I called Stanley Crouch, who’s a character. But he said, “Well, they… somebody’s gonna release it after you’re gone, anyway. You might as well let it out.” And then I called… I can’t think…
